name: human-org-buying
notes: H3: vanilla PurchaseOrgs breaks at the first conflicting candidate (~1 org per weekly pass). With the fix, extra passes buy past conflicts. Compare org counts with the vanilla run. First run (2026-10-18): 64 extra orgs bought by re-run passes in 120 days, but AI org totals at the end matched vanilla (355 vs 353): the extra orgs are shed again, so the fix churns money. FixOrgBuying stays OFF pending investigation. Purchases often REPLACE a councilor's weakest org (TryAddOrgToCouncilor moves it to the pool, then it is sold), so counts can't show upgrades; orgTiers (sum of org tiers on councilors) is the measure.
info: {f: (faction(first, f).get('orgs'), faction(last, f).get('orgs')) for f in ['ResistCouncil','DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
sum(faction(last, f).get('orgTiers', 0) - faction(first, f).get('orgTiers', 0) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil'])
